Use a concise title that describes the work, following the shared title rules:

Assign the issue's actual author

-->

## Summary

<!-- Describe the problem, why it matters, and the intended outcome. -->

## Scope

<!--
Define this issue's ownership and required deliverables. Identify behavior to
preserve and explicit exclusions. For an investigation, define what must be
decided without assuming an implementation is required.
-->

- Owned work and required deliverables.
- Behavior to preserve and work outside this issue.

## Acceptance Criteria

<!--
List observable outcomes that define completion, including relevant failure
behavior and preservation requirements. An investigation can complete with a
documented decision, rationale, and any follow-up plan, including a decision
to retain the current implementation. Record durable decisions in their
canonical repository owner or a linked durable source. For a placeholder,
replace the checklist with "Criteria pending scope agreement" rather than
inventing settled criteria.
-->

- [ ] Describe an observable completion criterion.

## Verification

<!--
Map the criteria to checks, scenarios, or review, with expected results and
evidence. Follow the repository's own verification guidance for applicable
readiness rather than copying a universal test checklist. Keep the plan here;
record detailed results, tested revisions, and reports in the implementing PR
and link them here when available. If no PR is needed, record the evidence here
or link its durable source. For an unresolved plan, use "Verification pending
scope agreement" rather than inventing settled checks.
-->

- Check or scenario, expected result, and evidence.

## Notes

<!--
Optional: delete this section when there is no supporting context. Add concise
evidence, implementation suggestions, or related work. Use Confirmed Decisions
and Open Questions subsections when useful; distinguish suggestions from agreed
requirements. Link longer specifications and delivery history instead of
accumulating full logs here.
-->

## Depends On

<!--
List actual prerequisites with issue links and explain what each must provide.
Describe external or not-yet-filed prerequisites without inventing a number.
Replace "None" when a prerequisite exists. Put coordination with related work
in Notes when it is not a prerequisite.
-->

- None.

## Blocks

<!--
List downstream issues with links and explain what this issue must provide.
If a downstream issue has not been created, describe it without inventing a
number. Replace "None" when there is a downstream dependency.
-->

- None.
